# AMD FSR API headers (FidelityFX SDK v2.4.0)

Unmodified MIT-licensed headers from AMD's FidelityFX SDK, tag `v2.4.0`
(<https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/FidelityFX-SDK>, `Kits/FidelityFX/api/include` and
`Kits/FidelityFX/upscalers/include`). See `LICENSE.md`.

Only the headers are compiled in. AMD's signed `amd_fidelityfx_loader_vk.dll` and
`amd_fidelityfx_upscaler_vk.dll` (from `Kits/FidelityFX/signedbin` of the same release) are loaded at
run time from the emulator's folder when the AMD FSR 4.1 option is selected.
